A FAMILY-RUN SCHOOL
Garden House is a caring family-run school guided by the Principals, Mr Christian Warland and Mrs Sophie Strafford, both of whom attended Garden House School as children. Mr Warland was Head of Garden House Boys’ School for fourteen years. Mrs Strafford was Registrar at Garden House for twenty-two years.
